classification_input.source: metric_status counts across all 12 metrics at the company anchor period
classification_input.validity: Every count is a non-negative integer and counts sum to exactly 12. Unknown statuses or invalid totals fail closed as INVALID_INPUT; they are never routed to a screening outcome.

priority_rules.meaning: At least one clean metric exists. This is permission to evaluate evidence, not a candidate decision.

priority_rules.when: OK = 0 AND every metric status is HOLD
priority_rules.meaning: All evidence is held; HOLD is not a negative signal.

priority_rules.when: OK = 0 AND every metric status is MISSING
priority_rules.meaning: No metric input exists; missing is not zero or no signal.

priority_rules.when: OK = 0 AND every metric status is NOT_COMPARABLE
priority_rules.meaning: No metric has a valid comparison period.

There is no clean metric and at least one provisional metric. Other non-evaluable statuses may coexist; preserve their counts and flags. A triggered provisional signal may enter L1 observation with its provisional flag. An absent trigger must remain in this watchlist and must not be converted to NO_SIGNAL or a candidate rejection.

priority_rules.when: OK = 0 AND PROVISIONAL = 0 AND every metric status is UNDEFINED_BASE
priority_rules.meaning: All ratio comparisons lack a meaningful base; this is not deterioration.

priority_rules.when: OK = 0 AND PROVISIONAL = 0 AND every metric status is in {NOT_APPLICABLE, EXCLUDED_SCOPE}
priority_rules.meaning: No metric is applicable to the recorded scope. Do not treat the company as a negative screen.

priority_rules.when: OK = 0 AND PROVISIONAL = 0 AND every metric status is VERSION_MISMATCH
OK = 0 AND PROVISIONAL = 0 AND no preceding homogeneous branch matched
priority_rules.meaning: A mixed combination of unavailable, incomparable, held, undefined-base, scope, or version statuses. Preserve the per-status vector and re-enter after the blocking cause is resolved. Never translate this branch into NO_SIGNAL or candidate rejection.

downstream_guardrails: L0 is an evidence-availability route and is not an L1 signal result or a shortlist decision.
EVALUABLE does not imply a positive signal or shortlist eligibility; S01 L1/L2 rules remain authoritative.

W5_PROVISIONAL_ONLY is a metric-layer observation bucket. With OK=0 across all 12 metrics, the current run cannot satisfy the clean L2 candidate gate; the L0 label itself neither rejects on signal grounds nor adds a candidate.

No OK does not mean no signal: evaluate provisional evidence under the frozen L1 rules and preserve its flag. An absent provisional trigger stays on the W5 watchlist; it is not converted into NO_SIGNAL.
L0 never assigns a company to a candidate list. Candidate inclusion requires the existing downstream evidence rules; W5 itself cannot add a candidate.
W1/W2/W4/W6/W7/W8/W9 are unresolved or out-of-scope evidence states, never NO_SIGNAL and never automatic rejection.
All input counts and the exact 9-status vector must remain in the S03 audit output.
migration_note: Apply as an additive L0 patch only after explicit rule-version handling in the parent workflow. The S01 v2 file and S02 historical outputs remain immutable. Recompute the L0 route from each company's current 12-cell status vector after upstream corrections; historical counts 377/17 are regression baselines, not expected post-correction counts.
